title: PPWR is in force, time to bury the three biggest myths around it
subtitle: Three myths are circulating about packaging and Digital Product Passports, and each has a precise answer in the text. The one obligation PPWR genuinely places on any passport is that a product carrier and packaging information must share a single data carrier.
featuredImageAlt: A faceted low-poly bottle in teal and coral, with a receding row of triangular polygon forms behind it and threads of light running through the facets, illustrating physical packaging linked to its digital data.
excerpt: Every product needs a QR code from 2026. Packaging needs a Digital Product Passport. Passports must carry packaging data. Three claims, all circulating since the Packaging Regulation became applicable on 12 August 2026, and none of them survives contact with the text. What PPWR does oblige is one shared data carrier where a product passport and packaging information meet.
